svg.aria-label: QCUTEDEV: student dev, AI enjoyer, future full-time dev. Status: shipping ML into real apps. Splash text: Now with ML! A night-time pixel block world with a far-off neon city and a cyan light beam; a pixel dev in a purple hoodie mines a diamond ore block that drops the skills one by one (python, java, docker...) while a creeper sneaks up from behind, hisses and poofs into smoke, above a game hotbar.
